description: This file defines a class `Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultConfigHandler` which provides a method to register a default configuration handler callback in the Smarty templating engine. It contains a class with a property and a method to assign a callback, throwing an exception if the callback is not callable.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultConfigHandler
classes.description: Provides functionality to register a default configuration handler callback in Smarty templates.

methods.name: registerDefaultConfigHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback as the default configuration handler. Throws an exception if the callback is not callable.
